newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1230 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1230 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1,230 contracts, compared with 1,156 contracts traded overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 77 wheat, 530 corn, 575 soybean, 31 soymeal and 14 soyoil futures contracts traded along with two soybean call and one soybean put options.

In overnight trading, wheat was three to 3-1/2 cents per bushel higher, corn 1/4 to one cent per bushel higher, soybeans 3-1/2 to 5-1/4 cents higher, soymeal unchanged to $1.80 per ton higher and soyoil unchanged.
